subject: Human acceptance of REQ-0001: Caregiver Home — prioritize monitored people who require attention
decision: ACCEPT the requirement to implement visual prioritization of monitored people based on glucose attention states.
reason: This feature directly addresses a critical caregiver workflow gap identified in Product Discovery (TESTRUN-2026-001). It reuses existing LibreCare glucose classification and safety semantics, carries no new medical rules, and delivers high user value with low implementation complexity.
evidence: TESTRUN-2026-001: Caregiver multi-person switching is discoverable but does not surface priority
Product Strategy: Caregiver is the primary mode/perspective
Product Discovery v3: Caregiver persona shows strong need for rapid attention identification in multi-person scenarios
counterargument: Users might habituate to warning sections. Mitigation: 'Wymaga uwagi' only appears when genuinely needed; no false positives.
revisit_condition: Revisit if user testing shows habituation or if attention-state classification becomes unreliable.
